description: Defines the internal sealed class XGraphicsPathItem which represents a segment of a drawing path with a specific type and associated points within the PdfSharp.Drawing namespace.

classes.name: XGraphicsPathItem
classes.description: Represents a segment of a path defined by a type and a set of points.

methods.name: XGraphicsPathItem
methods.description: Constructor initializing the path item with a specified type and optional points.

methods.name: XGraphicsPathItem
methods.description: Overloaded constructor that initializes the path item with a specified type and points (for GDI).

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the path item, including its points.
